decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has kept a dedicated page for two years, which signals ongoing commitment, and because it sits close to the core range its carrying cost is low while its value is still being proven.
The hyaluronic serum is still listed after two years and costs little to carry in small batches, so the option is worth keeping, though its modest visibility leaves some risk of a range cleanup.
The cleansing oil launched only in 2024 and probably replaces the dropped cleansing milk, so its uncertainty has not yet resolved and keeping it is cheap.
